report_discrepancies.note: General Fund budget-to-actual federal receipts lines as printed (19,862.00 + 26,665.02 + 1,544.00 + 33,627.00 + 2,531.06 + 10,000.00 + 85,198.68 = 179,427.76) are 1.40 less than the printed Total federal receipts 179,429.16 (which agrees with the governmental funds statement). One of the digits may be misread.

Activities Fund schedule Total row: Balance 9/1/2024 114,237.49 + Receipts 99,060.00 - Disbursements 131,835.77 + General Fund Support 35,000.00 = 116,461.72, but the printed Balance 8/31/2025 total is 120,416.38 (3,954.66 higher). The Activities fund balance elsewhere in the report (pp3, 9) is 116,461.72; figures kept as printed.

notes: Modified cash basis school district (FY ended 8/31/2025). Governmental funds statement (pp3-4; total column on p4) used for receipts/disbursements; no business-type funds (School Nutrition is shown as a governmental fund in this report). Beginning/ending cash are the fund balances (all cash). Transfers between funds (General to School Nutrition 55,000 and General to Activities 35,000) are shown in the fund columns but eliminated in the Reclassification column, so the total column has none; top-level transfers are null. In detail they appear as other financing (General Fund exhibit lines 912 and 913 as -55,000/-35,000; matching +55,000 in School Nutrition p10 and +35,000 General Fund Support in Activities p20); the General Fund exhibit total 3,837,590.01 includes the 90,000. Combined statement lines were split using the fund schedules: Local receipts (property tax includes Bond Fund 187,411.28; matches Statement of Activities p2), County receipts, Support services (pupil transportation 183,113.93 separated), Debt service. 'Interest' 98,486.94 split using the fund schedules: 3,797.62 interest on taxes (1140, p6 and p11) as property tax and 94,689.32 as investment income. Detail: General Fund spending is recorded only from the Schedule of Cash Disbursements of Operational Expenses (pp14-19; program x object), which supersedes the function-only General Fund disbursements schedule on p7; zero-actual lines are omitted. The General Fund budget schedule p6 is the receipts detail. The Depreciation Fund (p8) is a separate fund inside the 'General w/ Depreciation' column of the statement. Activities Fund is recorded account by account from the p20 FY2025 schedule (nonzero receipts and disbursements only; receipts include 3,968.03 of interest); the one-line Activities budget schedule p9 is left out. Qualified Capital Purpose Undertaking Fund (p13) had no actual activity (budget 181 only), so no lines. Page 21 is the prior-year (FY2024) Activities Fund schedule and is not recorded. Budget comparison p5 and Statement of Activities p2 are not recorded in detail. Roll-forward: 3,013,035.39 + 4,735,446.48 - 4,543,522.19 = 3,204,959.68. Balance sheet is the modified-cash Statement of Net Position (no liabilities). Read pages 1-21 of 21
